tasks.title: Close source delivery with purity and expectation parity
tasks.goal: Demonstrate zero hidden effects and exact integrity outcomes across surfaces.
steps: Instrument isolated provider/network/filesystem boundaries and capture initial manifest/lock/cache/settings bytes.
Run success, missing capture, strict proof, tamper and stale-expectation queries on each surface.
Compare validated outcomes, counters and before/after bytes; retain exact evidence rather than a PASS assertion.
positive_cases: Prepared offline query is repeatable and leaves captured state unchanged.
negative_cases: Empty cache never fetches/hydrates; poisoned proof and changed expectations cannot succeed.
acceptance: Zero-effect counters accompany matching CLI/MCP/service results.
Integrity strength and unavailable proof remain explicit.
